quotes.text: Some things don't ask to be finished. They just ask to be returned to.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: You do not have to earn the right to rest.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: The quiet parts of the day are not empty. They are just unmeasured.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Attention is the simplest form of love.
quotes.author: Simone Weil

quotes.text: Nothing is ever really lost to us as long as we remember it.
quotes.author: L.M. Montgomery

quotes.text: A slow walk is still a walk forward.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: You are allowed to take up the same space you did yesterday.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: The plant does not rush toward the sun. It just keeps facing it.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Being seen by no one does not make a moment less real.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Small and unfinished is still a shape worth keeping.
quotes.author: Unknown
